@Roth.Θ_le_of_forall_index_le : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {B : ℝ},
  1 ≤ B →
    ∀ {q r : σ → ℕ} {c : ℝ},
      (∀ R ∈ Roth.RSet B r,
          ∀ (h : σ → ℤ),
            (∀ (j : σ), IsCoprime (h j) ↑(q j)) →
              Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R) (fun j ↦ ↑(h j) / ↑(q j)) r ≤ c) →
        Roth.Θ B q r ≤ c

theorem Roth.Θ_le_of_forall_index_le.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {B : ℝ},
  1 ≤ B →
    ∀ {q r : σ → ℕ} {c : ℝ},
      (∀ R ∈ Roth.RSet B r,
          ∀ (h : σ → ℤ),
            (∀ (j : σ), IsCoprime (h j) ↑(q j)) →
              Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R) (fun j ↦ ↑(h j) / ↑(q j)) r ≤ c) →
        Roth.Θ B q r ≤ c :=
fun {σ} [Fintype σ] {B} hB {q r} {c} hc ↦
  csSup_le (Roth.indexSet_nonempty hB q r) fun b a ↦
    Exists.casesOn a fun R h ↦
      And.casesOn h fun hR right ↦ Exists.casesOn right fun h h_1 ↦ And.casesOn h_1 fun hh right ↦ right ▸ hc R hR h hh

THETAUPPER190_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {B : ℝ},
  1 ≤ B →
    ∀ {q r : σ → ℕ} {c : ℝ},
      (∀ R ∈ Roth.RSet B r,
          ∀ (h : σ → ℤ),
            (∀ (j : σ), IsCoprime (h j) ↑(q j)) →
              Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R) (fun (j : σ) ↦ ↑(h j) / ↑(q j)) r ≤ c) →
        Roth.Θ B q r ≤ c
